subject: Rename 'redis_tls_ctx' and 'redis_tls_client_ctx' global variables (#268)
reason: The change only renames the internal global variables redis_tls_ctx/redis_tls_client_ctx to valkey_tls_ctx/valkey_tls_client_ctx in src/tls.c and src/sentinel.c. Control flow, TLS configuration, cleanup and connection creation are unchanged; the symbols are not externally visible behaviour (not a config name, command, reply or file format), so any error would be a compile/link failure caught at build time. A pure refactor with no observable behaviour change needs no scenario.
